Let’s Go Duplex Shopping In Killeen, TX 
In today’s video, I take you on a side-by-side walkthrough of two nearly identical duplexes that sit just doors apart… but their performance, condition, and profitability tell two very different stories.

🔍 At first glance, these two properties look like twins – same layout, similar curb appeal, and only $15,000 apart in listing price ($310K vs $325K). But dig deeper, and you’ll find out why one of these is a cash-flowing rental goldmine, while the other might cost you in the long run.

🎥 In this video, I’ll break down:
✅ The crucial renovations and upgrades that boost rental income
✅ How one duplex earns $1,245/month in rent while the other earns only $900
✅ What you MUST inspect beyond paint and flooring
✅ The importance of local market rent comps and tenant expectations
✅ Simple improvements that can massively increase ROI
✅ How savvy investors analyze cash flow vs. cost

💼 Whether you’re a first-time investor looking to break into multifamily real estate, or a seasoned buyer looking for your next deal, this comparison will give you clear, practical insights into what really makes a property worth the price.

📍 These two duplexes are located in the same neighborhood, on the same street – yet their financial performance is miles apart. You’ll learn how to spot value, avoid overpaying, and maximize your returns with smart, strategic choices.

06:05 – Inside Duplex #2 ($325K) – Renovated and Rent-Ready
08:10 – Rent Breakdown: $900 vs $1,245 – Why the Huge Gap?
09:30 – Renovation Insights: What Adds Value (and What Doesn’t)
11:00 – ROI and Cash Flow Analysis – Numbers That Matter
12:45 – Mistakes New Investors Make When Choosing Properties
14:10 – Final Verdict: Which Duplex Would I Buy (And Why)
15:30 – Takeaways: What You Should Look For in Your Next Deal
16:15 – Outro & What’s Next on the Channel
